headline: Crude bomb-like objects found at Buddhijibi Graveyard and Sher-e-Bangla Nagar
summary: Authorities recovered suspicious items resembling crude bombs from two locations in Dhaka, prompting security concerns. The objects were found at Buddhijibi Graveyard and Sher-e-Bangla Nagar.
details: Police and bomb disposal units have recovered several crude bomb-like objects from two separate locations in Dhaka. The first discovery was made at the Buddhijibi Graveyard, followed by another find in the Sher-e-Bangla Nagar area.

The nature and origin of these objects are currently under investigation. Security forces have cordoned off the areas and are working to determine if the items are indeed explosive devices and to neutralize any potential threat.

The recovery of these suspicious items has raised concerns about public safety and potential subversive activities. Authorities are urging the public to remain vigilant and report any unusual findings to the police immediately.

headline_marked: Dengue claims 8 more lives, [[2,036 hospitalized]] in 24 hours
headline: Dengue claims 8 more lives, 2,036 hospitalized in 24 hours
summary: The country's dengue death toll this year has climbed to 233, with a significant surge in new cases and fatalities reported in the last 24 hours.
details: At least eight more dengue patients have died and 2,036 others have been hospitalized in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00 AM today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
The latest fatalities include two from Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC), one from Dhaka South City Corporation (DSCC), and one each from Barishal, Khulna, Rajshahi, and Rangpur divisions.
With these new figures, the total number of dengue-related deaths across the country this year has reached 233. The total number of dengue cases recorded so far this year stands at 75,730.
caption:
Dengue outbreak intensifies: 8 deaths and 2,036 new hospitalizations reported in just 24 hours.

At least eight more dengue patients have died and 2,036 others have been hospitalized in the 24 hours leading up to 8:00 AM today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

The latest fatalities include two from Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC), one from Dhaka South City Corporation (DSCC), and one each from Barishal, Khulna, Rajshahi, and Rangpur divisions.

With these new figures, the total number of dengue-related deaths across the country this year has reached 233. The total number of dengue cases recorded so far this year stands at 75,730.
